entries.title: Your first mate knows when a panel is folded or in More
entries.body: When your window is too short for every panel, the first mate now knows which panels are folded to their headers and which are in a rail's More row, instead of calling them shown. A crewmate building a panel for you hears the same and tells you where it sits.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the first mate and crewmates now say where a folded panel sits.
